fixture.notes: Controlled state, not a naturally acquired full-run deck. Both Sporeling move keys are explicitly assigned identical three-damage moves. Current-turn Kindle/Art already used. Later legal Kindle/Art alternatives are included in the bounded search. Every remaining card fits into each native draw, so hidden order cannot alter this witness.

rolling_horizon_prototype.changes: Stop subtracting elapsed fight age from a fresh fixed lookahead; retain bounded circulation and native terminal dominance. Optional flag defaults off. No native gameplay change.

claim_boundary: The old heuristic chooses a losing first action in this finite controlled state. A winning continuation is found; every bounded legal continuation after Strike loses. This neither proves general optimality of the repair nor establishes natural exposure, route independence or P9. The initial 20-HP diagnostic had winning continuations after both choices and is retained separately, not presented as a counterexample.
